tips.text: Use Siphon Power on the enemy, then hit them with your next attack. You get a shield and bonus damage, so it wins short trades.
Put Gravity Field on enemies who are walking into a fight or standing still. Staying inside it long enough gets them stunned, and until then they are slowed.
Poke with Hextech Ray down a lane full of minions. It goes through everything it touches, so it can hit enemies standing behind minions.
Cast Hextech Ray over a wall when you want sight of the area behind it. The beam gives vision where it lands.
Last-hit minions as often as you can. Each kill gives Hex Fragments, which unlock your augments.
Start Arcane Storm on a group of enemies. It follows a champion it hit, and you can recast it to steer it onto someone else.
Use Arcane Storm on enemies who are channeling an ability. The first hit interrupts them.
Chain your abilities for a kill. Gravity Field first to hold them, then Hextech Ray and Siphon Power while they are stuck.
Keep minions between you and Ahri so Charm hits them first and stops there.
Put Gravity Field where Ahri will dash or retreat; she is slowed there and can be stunned if she stays.
Use Hextech Ray to poke Ahri while she walks up to farm; she has to give up wave position to dodge it.
Trade with Siphon Power and follow with an attack; the shield makes Ahri's Orb of Deception poke weaker.
Play carefully when Spirit Rush is ready; she can reposition and burst you. Push when it is on cooldown.
Land Arcane Storm on Ahri after she commits; it follows her.
Place Gravity Field on yourself or where Akali will land when she dives; it slows her and stuns her if she stays.
Use Siphon Power when she dashes in; the shield helps you survive her burst.
Aim Hextech Ray at her smoke when she hides in Twilight Shroud; area spells reveal her briefly.
Poke her when her energy is low, since Five Point Strike costs a lot and she cannot trade freely.
Play safe at level 6 when your health is low; Perfect Execution can finish you.
Drop Gravity Field on Akshan when he swings in or walks up to trade; staying inside leaves him slowed and then stunned.
Use Siphon Power on Akshan before you trade. The shield soaks his poke, and your next attack hits harder.
Aim Hextech Ray along the path he walks, since the ray reaches far and keeps going through targets. Poke him when he steps up to last-hit.
Arcane Storm follows Akshan once it hits him, so use it to chase him down. It also gives away where he is if he hides.
Keep your distance from Flash Frost. Step out of its line, since a hit slows you and the ice stuns at the end of its range.
Use Siphon Power on Anivia in trades. The shield softens her Frostbite.
Drop Gravity Field on Anivia when she is pushed against your minions. If she stays inside, she is stunned.
Hextech Ray the lane to push her back. Her egg is hard to kill early, so save your all-in for when she has used Rebirth.
Arcane Storm follows Anivia once it hits her, so cast it on her when she walks away from a trade.
Poke Annie with Hextech Ray and Siphon Power when she steps up to last-hit; the shield from Siphon Power softens her return trade.
Check Annie's Pyromania counter. When it is full, stay out of her range; her stun comes from Disintegrate or Incinerate.
Put Gravity Field where Annie must stand to fight you; she is stunned if she stays inside.
After Annie summons Tibbers, back away from him and use Arcane Storm on her group to make her pull the bear back.
Do not let Annie shield herself and trade into you; her Molten Shield hurts you when you hit it.
Put Gravity Field on Aurelion Sol when he channels Breath of Light; he has to stand still to keep the beam on you and gets stunned if he stays inside.
Walk out of Singularity's edge early; it drags you toward the center, and low health there means instant death.
Stay out of the black hole's reach and poke with Hextech Ray from the side, where you can step away freely.
Use Siphon Power on him before a trade; the shield soaks his beam and the empowered attack adds damage.
Move away from where Falling Star will land as soon as you see it; it lands after a delay and stuns whoever is still there.
Watch for his Astral Flight dash to close the gap; stun or slow him with Gravity Field when he lands near you.
Put Gravity Field where Aurora lands after Across the Veil; she is invisible only briefly, and the field slows her and stuns her if she stays inside.
Use Siphon Power on Aurora when she steps up to trade; the shield softens her return hit and you get a stronger next attack.
Fire Hextech Ray along the path she hops to when dodging; it is a line, so aim where she will be.
Stay out of the circle from Between Worlds; enemies crossing its border are slowed, and Aurora can hop across it to chase you.
Respect Aurora's The Weirding when you stand close; it slows you hard, so keep Gravity Field ready to answer if she follows up.
Put Gravity Field where Azir's Sand Soldiers stand when he fights you; he is slowed inside it and stunned if he stays in it.
Poke Azir with Hextech Ray from long range while he has no soldiers out, since he needs a soldier to dash or to attack with.
Use Siphon Power when you trade; its shield soaks some of his soldier damage and your next attack hits harder.
Stay out of the line of Emperor's Divide at level 6. Save Gravity Field for after he commits so you can lock him down.
Place Arcane Storm on Azir when he is trapped or dashing in; it follows him and keeps hitting.
Dodge Sear. Without a first hit from Brand, he cannot stun you.
Place Gravity Field where Brand will step to dodge, then threaten him with Hextech Ray while he is slowed.
Stay away from your own minions when Brand is looking to cast Conflagration, because it spreads to them and to you.
Move away from allies when Pyroclasm is cast. It starts slowly and bounces between enemies.
Use Siphon Power to trade, and use its shield to absorb Brand's burst.
Pillar of Flame has a delay, so keep moving after Brand casts it and you can step out.
Keep Gravity Field ready for when Briar leaps in; she gets slowed and, if she stays inside, stunned.
Stay far from Briar and poke with Hextech Ray; Viktor is much stronger when she cannot reach him.
Use Siphon Power when Briar jumps on you; its shield soaks the first hits.
Put Arcane Storm on Briar when she is low or has used her jump; its damage keeps following her.
Place Gravity Field where Cassiopeia stands to fight. She is slowed, and she is stunned if she stays inside.
Use Hextech Ray to poke Cassiopeia when she lines up Noxious Blast. It punishes her for standing still.
Walk out of Noxious Blast's delay; it lands after a brief pause, so move before it explodes.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as she casts Petrifying Gaze so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Use Siphon Power for its shield when you trade with Cassiopeia. Her poison damage hurts less.
Put Gravity Field under Diana when she dives onto you; if she stays inside she gets stunned, and it slows her either way.
Use Siphon Power on Diana when she comes in; the shield soaks her burst and the empowered attack hurts if she stays close.
Poke with Hextech Ray from range while Diana has no Moonlight, and keep your distance so she cannot jump on you.
Hold Gravity Field until Diana has used Lunar Rush; she has few ways to escape afterwards.
Cast Arcane Storm on Diana when she commits. It follows her once it hits, so she cannot easily run from it.
Put Gravity Field where Ekko wants to fight or stand; staying inside it long enough gets him stunned.
Use Siphon Power on Ekko when he walks up to trade; the shield absorbs some of his damage and your empowered attack hits back.
Poke with Hextech Ray from a distance so Ekko must come to you, and keep away from his Timewinder line.
Save Arcane Storm for after Ekko has used Chronobreak, or he can rewind out of the damage.
Aim Hextech Ray through the minions at Ezreal. It passes through them, so it hits him in his poke range.
Place Gravity Field where Ezreal will walk or land. He is stunned if he stays in it, so cast it on his Arcane Shift landing spot.
Use Siphon Power on Ezreal to get a shield before you trade. It absorbs his poke.
Stand behind minions so Mystic Shot hits them first. It stops at the first enemy it hits.
Cast Arcane Storm on Ezreal once he has used Arcane Shift. The storm keeps following him and he has no easy escape.
Ezreal is fragile, so trade when his abilities are on cooldown and close in on him.
Save Gravity Field for when Fizz commits. Place it where he lands and he is slowed, then stunned if he stays inside.
Don't spend Hextech Ray when Fizz can answer with Playful. Wait until he has used it, then fire.
Use Siphon Power as Fizz dashes in; the shield cuts his burst. It also gives you a strong follow-up attack.
Stay out of a long line from Fizz, since Chum the Waters hits harder the farther it flies. Keep minions in front of you so he can't get a clean throw.
Poke Galio with Hextech Ray from range; he is slower while charging Shield of Durand.
Stay out of Galio's reach when Shield of Durand is charging; a full charge taunts you for longer.
Don't stand in a straight line from Galio; Justice Punch knocks you up and sets up his follow-up.
Place Gravity Field where Galio must walk through to reach you, and keep him inside it.
Hit Galio with Hero's Entrance interrupts in mind: stun or disrupt him before he jumps into the air.
Galio cannot cross walls with Justice Punch, so stand behind terrain to stay safe from his dash.
Use Gravity Field on Hwei when he stands still to cast; the enemy is slowed, then stunned if they stay inside.
Rush Hwei right after he casts a Torment spell; he is open to being run down then.
Trade with Siphon Power; it hits from long range and the shield softens the damage you take back.
Aim Hextech Ray where Hwei will step to dodge. His spells are slow to cast, so he cannot easily answer it.
Keep Gravity Field for when Irelia dashes in. If she stays in it she is slowed and then stunned.
Don't fire your big spells into Defiant Dance. She takes much less damage while charging, so wait for the swipe to end.
Poke her with Hextech Ray while she waits for Bladesurge to come back. Stay away from minions she can dash through.
Her Flawless Duet stun is the thing to dodge. Step out of the line between the blades as they close.
Use Siphon Power as she dashes onto you. Its shield absorbs her burst and the empowered attack punishes her.
Keep Kassadin away with Hextech Ray and Siphon Power early; he is weak before level 6.
Place Gravity Field where Kassadin will land after he uses Riftwalk; the slow and stun punish his dive.
Do not start Arcane Storm while Kassadin has Null Sphere ready; it can interrupt your cast.
Kassadin takes reduced magic damage, so use your Siphon Power empowered attack to add damage when you trade.
Hold your slows for when Kassadin jumps in; Force Pulse and Riftwalk are his only ways to reach you quickly, so punish him right after.
Put Gravity Field where Katarina wants to land, or on a Dagger she is about to pick up. Staying inside it gets her stunned.
Use Hextech Ray to poke her when she walks up to last-hit; it is a long line she must sidestep.
Keep Siphon Power ready for when she dives in; its shield soaks her burst.
Cast Arcane Storm on her when she uses Death Lotus; the first hit disrupts her channel.
Do not trade when she has Daggers on the ground. Picking them up resets Shunpo quickly, so she can jump onto you again.
Stand where LeBlanc cannot easily reach you, and aim Hextech Ray at the spot she dashes into.
Put Gravity Field where LeBlanc will land, or on yourself when she comes in. It slows her and stuns her if she stays in it.
Use Siphon Power when she starts a trade. The shield soaks part of her burst, and your empowered attack hits back.
Do not chase LeBlanc after she uses Distortion. She can return to where she started.
Dodge Ethereal Chains by stepping out of line before it connects, or it will root you.
Be careful when LeBlanc has Mimic ready at level 6. Her combo hits much harder, so stay away from her at that point.
Stay out of Ring of Frost range and walk up only when it is on cooldown; if it roots you, Viktor has little way out.
Poke with Hextech Ray from long range, since Lissandra has to come close to hit you with most of her kit.
Hold Gravity Field for when Lissandra uses Glacial Path to dive on you. Staying inside it long enough stuns her.
Trade with Siphon Power and a basic attack. Its shield softens the return damage from Ice Shard.
Dodge Ice Shard by standing behind your minions; it only slows the first enemy it hits.
Save your Arcane Storm for when she is committed. Her Frozen Tomb on you ends your trade, so keep your distance from her when it is ready.
Keep Gravity Field on Lux's landing spot after she steps up; she has to leave or get stunned.
Stay out of Light Binding's line, and keep minions between you and Lux so it hits them first.
Siphon Power's shield helps you win trades; use it when Lux walks up to hit minions.
Hextech Ray outranges Lux's approach and pokes her at the start of lane, so lead with it.
Move away from Lucent Singularity before it blows up; it slows you and sets up Light Binding.
Sidestep when Lux's red Final Spark warning shows; it can hit you from very far away.
Keep Gravity Field ready for when Malzahar walks forward, then step away from his Malefic Visions.
Step out of the portals of Call of the Void as they open. Getting silenced there stops your abilities.
Hit Malzahar with Hextech Ray from range, since Void Shift only blocks him from being stunned and not from a wave push. Wait until he has taken damage.
Stay clear of minions carrying Malefic Visions, because it spreads to you if they die.
Use Siphon Power on Malzahar to shield yourself against his damage before he starts his combo.
Hold Hextech Ray and Siphon Power until Mel has used Rebuttal; it destroys projectiles that touch it, so baiting it out makes your next poke land.
Stay out of Solar Snare range, since being rooted far from her lasts longest. Sidestep the orb, or you eat her follow-up.
Drop Gravity Field on her when she steps up to trade; she is slowed, and staying inside stuns her.
Back off when you are low on health. Her hits build up Overwhelm, and once it adds up to enough, one more hit kills you.
Use Arcane Storm once she is hurt; it follows her around and keeps damaging her while she runs.
Put Gravity Field under Naafiri when she commits; staying inside it gets her stunned, and she has few ways to cut the fight short.
Keep Siphon Power for when she jumps on you. Its shield soaks her burst, and the empowered attack hits back.
Hextech Ray her from long range while she is far away. She has to close the gap before she can hurt you.
Be careful when her Hounds' Pursuit is ready. She can dash to you from far away, so stay near your team after level 6.
Fight her when she has used Eviscerate. Her escape is on cooldown, so she cannot easily leave your Gravity Field.
Her packmates add damage, so avoid trading in melee range with her.
Walk up and use Siphon Power on Orianna when the Ball is far from her. She cannot hit you back well without it.
Use Gravity Field on Orianna when she tries to fight you. She is slowed and then stunned if she stays inside.
Stay spread out from the Ball when you are near it. Command: Shockwave pulls you in and stuns you, and it is dangerous at level 6.
Use Hextech Ray to push Orianna away from her Ball. Her damage depends on where the Ball is.
Place Gravity Field where Qiyana will land after she dashes in; if she stays inside it she is stunned.
Use Siphon Power on Qiyana when she trades; the shield soaks her burst and your next attack hits harder.
Keep Hextech Ray for when she walks up to a river or brush; it is a long line, so you can poke her before she gets close.
Stay away from walls and brush edges when her Supreme Display of Talent is ready; it stuns around terrain borders.
Hold Arcane Storm until she commits her dash; the storm follows her and is hard to escape.
Stay out of Ryze's Spell Flux range. Once he marks you, his other spells hit harder and Rune Prison roots you.
Drop Gravity Field on Ryze when he is rooting you or walking in. It slows him and stuns him if he stays inside.
Use Siphon Power on Ryze before he trades. The shield soaks some of his spells.
Aim Hextech Ray where Ryze will stand, such as when he walks up to cast. Hold it until he commits, because it is easy to dodge.
Use Arcane Storm on Ryze when he is low on mana or health. He has no escape except walking, and the storm follows him.
If Ryze starts Realm Warp, stun him with Gravity Field to cancel the portal.
Aim Hextech Ray down the line Sylas will walk to dash in; it is a long beam, so he takes damage while closing in on you.
Put Gravity Field where Sylas will land after Abscond or Abduct. If he stays inside, he is slowed and then stunned.
Use Siphon Power on Sylas before he trades. The shield soaks his burst and the next attack hits harder.
Stay out of his range and don't let him close the gap freely. Sylas wins short, close fights where Kingslayer heals him.
Save Arcane Storm for when Sylas is committed. The storm follows him after the first hit, which makes escaping hard.
Stay out of Scatter the Weak's line when a Dark Sphere is near you; a pushed sphere stuns you.
Trade right after Syndra uses Scatter the Weak; its long cooldown leaves her with little to stop you.
Use Siphon Power to shield yourself while trading, then hit with the empowered attack.
Aim Hextech Ray where Syndra stands to farm; it also pokes her.
Put Gravity Field on Syndra when she commits to a fight; she is slowed and stunned if she stays in it.
Cast Arcane Storm on Syndra when she is low; it follows her once it hits.
Stay out of Taliyah's Seismic Shove range when Unraveled Earth is on the ground; being thrown into the stones gets you stunned and hurt.
Her Threaded Volley flies in a straight line, so step sideways when she aims at you instead of walking back.
Use Siphon Power to trade with Taliyah; the shield makes up for the damage her rocks deal back.
Aim Hextech Ray along the path she walks to dodge, because it keeps travelling through anyone it hits and has long reach.
Put Gravity Field on her when she walks into it or is cornered; if she stays inside she is stunned.
At level 6, Arcane Storm lets you chase her; it follows her even through terrain, and her wall does not stop it.
Place Gravity Field where Talon lands or will run. Stay out of melee range, because the stun only works if he stays inside it.
Use Siphon Power on Talon before he jumps in. Its shield absorbs part of his burst.
Poke with Hextech Ray when Talon walks up to last-hit. Stay at range so his Noxian Diplomacy is not a surprise.
Talon is far weaker once Shadow Assault is on cooldown. Trade more freely then, and fear him when it is ready.
Hold Arcane Storm until Talon is committed. It follows him after he turns invisible, and the damage keeps ticking.
Watch the lane for Talon disappearing. He can vault walls with Assassin's Path to roam, so ping your team.
Combine Gravity Field with Hextech Ray: the slow makes the ray much easier to land on Twisted Fate.
Keep away when Twisted Fate is shuffling cards; a Gold Card attack stuns you. Stay out of his attack range or wait for the card to be used.
Use Siphon Power to trade from range; the shield absorbs part of his Wild Cards return poke.
Watch for Destiny at level 6; when he reveals the map, expect a gank or a teleport and retreat early.
Wild Cards fan out in a cone; stand off to the side of his aim rather than directly in line, and dodge it early when your health is low.
Walk around the edge of Event Horizon, not through it. You only get stunned when you cross its edge.
Veigar is fragile. Land Hextech Ray and Siphon Power on him when he steps up to last-hit.
Watch the ground for Dark Matter and sidestep it once it appears. Dodging it costs Veigar a lot of mana.
Put Gravity Field on Veigar when he is stuck in a trade. He is slowed and then stunned if he stays inside.
Do not let Veigar hit you with Baleful Strike. Each champion he hits makes him permanently stronger.
Keep your health up once you hit level 6. Primordial Burst deals far more damage to a low-health target.
Keep Gravity Field on the spot Vex wants to stand in; she is slowed inside it, and if she stays she gets stunned.
Trade with Siphon Power when Vex steps up. The shield softens her return damage, and your next attack hits harder.
Stay out of Mistral Bolt's long range, and don't line up in a straight path from her.
Don't let Vex get close when her empowered ability is ready. Her fear can leave you open to her follow-up.
Hold Arcane Storm for when Vex has used her Shadow Surge. The storm follows her wherever she goes.
Use Hextech Ray to poke her while she walks up to last-hit.
Keep Vladimir at range with Hextech Ray and Siphon Power. He wins when he gets close and heals off his trades.
Place Gravity Field where Vladimir will walk to trade. Hold it back if he still has Sanguine Pool, since he can use the pool to get out.
Hit Vladimir with your abilities when he is low on Health, before Hemoplague can heal him. Hemoplague also makes him take extra damage.
Don't stand in the pool's area when Vladimir drops Sanguine Pool, because it slows you and damages you.
Close the distance on Xerath. Without space to poke, he has to rely on landing Shocking Orb.
Walk to the side of Shocking Orb's path. It flies in a straight line, so it is easy to dodge once you see him aim it.
Hit Xerath with Siphon Power when he is charging Arcanopulse. The shield absorbs some of the return trade.
Put Gravity Field on Xerath when he is close. If he stays inside it he gets stunned, and he has little to escape with.
Move out of Rite of the Arcane's circles as soon as you see them. Each shot lands after a delay, so keep moving.
Trade with Hextech Ray when Xin Zhao walks up to the wave, and keep your distance. He wants to stick to you.
Place Gravity Field on top of Xin Zhao right after he charges in. If he stays inside, he gets stunned.
Use Siphon Power for its shield when Xin Zhao's attacks are about to land. His third Three Talon Strike hit knocks you up.
Spread your spells out, since Xin Zhao slows you with Wind Becomes Lightning. Stay away from his thrust line.
Drop Arcane Storm on Xin Zhao when he commits. It follows him and keeps hurting him if he chases you.
Place Gravity Field where Yasuo will dash or stand; staying inside it gets him slowed and then stunned.
Don't count on Hextech Ray to hit through Wind Wall. Wait for the wall to drop, then fire.
Use Siphon Power on Yasuo when you trade; the shield softens his poke and the empowered attack adds damage.
Keep your distance from Yasuo, since his dash lets him close in fast. Stun him with Gravity Field when he commits.
Arcane Storm follows champions it has hit, so it punishes a Yasuo who is dashing around. Use it in a fight, not to poke.
Put Gravity Field on Yone when he dashes in; staying inside it gets him slowed and then stunned, so he can't just walk through.
Poke with Hextech Ray from long range while he has to walk up to you. Yone has no ranged attack, so you can punish him for stepping forward.
Cast Siphon Power on him before he reaches you; the shield soaks his first trade, and your next attack hits harder.
Stay spread from your minions and wait for his Mortal Steel stacks to run out. Two hits make it dash and knock you up.
Arcane Storm sticks to the champions it hits, so use it when he dashes in or after he commits with Fate Sealed. Re-aim it if he escapes.
Keep Gravity Field under Zed when he dashes in; staying inside it leaves him slowed and then stunned, so he can't finish his combo.
Use Siphon Power as Zed starts a trade; the shield soaks his burst and Viktor's next attack hits hard.
Poke Zed with Hextech Ray from a distance when he is out of energy, and step back from his shurikens.
Once Zed uses Death Mark, run away from him and fight back with Arcane Storm so the storm keeps hitting him as he hits you.
Keep Gravity Field ready for after Zed uses Living Shadow, since he has less mobility while it is on cooldown.
Stay out of Zoe's Sleepy Trouble Bubble range and watch her cooldown; once it is spent, step up and trade freely.
Hit Zoe with Hextech Ray when she walks up to farm. It is a long line she has to dodge sideways.
Use Siphon Power on Zoe to trade; the shield absorbs some of her return poke.
Drop Gravity Field on Zoe after she jumps with Portal Jump. She cannot walk out of it while she is stuck waiting.
Use Arcane Storm on Zoe once she is committed. It follows her and punishes her for running.
